item.title: Blacklisted: How Immortal Technique Built a Bare Metal Machine from the Ground Up
item.description: In the early 2000s, underground hip-hop artist Immortal Technique bypassed the institutional gateways and built a sovereign bare-metal machine. Operating outside of the major-label ecosystem, he built a massive, self-sustaining cultural presence without corporate radio support, television rotation, or institutional endorsement.
